authority: Owner correction: 1b cannot allow clarification questions; one description, one decision.
status: contract before opening the reserved description subset; no independent result yet
supersedes: Only the 1b routes, clarification and resolved-input scoring provisions of recognition_qualification_v1.json. Historical contracts and receipts remain unchanged.
engine: Use algsolve.answer.answer with the same approved reference catalog, embedding retrieval, candidate comparison and public checking as 1a. No separate interactive architecture.
input: Initial description and any initially supplied public examples only. No oracle signature, target key, private checks, requirements annotation or predetermined clarification replies.
output: Stored code when identity and qualification are justified; otherwise abstention. No generation, composition, follow-up or confirmation questions.
ambiguity: When the initial request admits materially different answers, abstention is required. Do not score a match to the hidden resolved target as success. Ignore all clarification metadata and resolved inputs.
reserved_data: The original 12 complete_description and four ambiguous_description cases remain sealed. The original four absent cases were consumed by 1a-v1 and cannot count as fresh 1b evidence.
evaluation: Freeze candidate and evaluator before opening; preserve author/reviewer provenance and composition exclusions. Private checks score only returned answers, after the decision. No tuning on protected outputs.
evidence_boundary: Earlier scripted dialogue selections do not establish one-shot understanding. Missing public examples cannot bypass the existing execution gate. Report this limitation explicitly.
